messages.subject: Project Cedar — mutual NDA for execution
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Good to be working opposite you again. Further to our call, I attach the mutual NDA for Project Cedar (Halstead Aerospace / Caldera Mobility). It is on a balanced, five-year confidentiality footing and should be uncontroversial. Subject to any comments from your side, we propose both parties sign this week so the technical exchange can begin.

Grateful for your sign-off or mark-up by Thursday.

Kind regards,
James

James Osei | Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0521
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
